WITH inserted AS (
			INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, bio, deleted_at)
			VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
			RETURNING id, name, email, bio, is_active, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
		),
		audited AS (
			INSERT INTO users_audit (id, parent_id, version, snapshot, valid_from)
			SELECT $6, id, 1, to_jsonb(inserted.*), NOW() FROM inserted
		)
		SELECT id, name, email, bio, is_active, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM inserted

SELECT id, name, email, bio, is_active, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
		FROM users
		WHERE id = $1
